t: This is St Luke's Church, on Sydney Street in Chelsea, just off the King's Road. James Savage designed it in 1819, and it is one of the earliest Gothic Revival churches in London, perhaps the earliest to be a complete new construction. It is Grade I listed, and received a Parliamentary grant under the Church Building Act of 1818. Savage also worked at Lincoln Cathedral and St Mary-le-Bow, and later wrote against slavish imitation of historical styles. The actress Martha Stageldoir is buried here. The gardens are listed too.
